summary: Lyons woman went hiking ~10:30 a.m. July 11 near 500 Taylor Rd, expected back ~3 hours later; reported overdue in the early evening. BCSO + various local rescue teams searched from 7:30 p.m.; found ~9:30 p.m. uninjured after searchers heard her air horn — she had become disoriented and decided to wait for daylight.
location: area of 500 Taylor Rd, near Lyons
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office + local rescue teams
notes: Run 751 Boulder Weekly chunk: SAR item hidden under crime-titled blotter page 'Elderly exploitation' (2010-07-15); date 2010-07-11 Sunday-verified. Parent-opened.
